marcel_mauss.scope: Library metadata identifies Marcel Mauss, W. D. Halls and the English Routledge 1990 manifestation. The indexed City Library record separately names Halls as translator and Mary Douglas as foreword author. This is distinct from Jane I. Guyer’s expanded 2016 translation selected in the biography. Metadata/title concordance only; no new book-body reading.

Indexed institutional catalogue fields identify the 1990 English translation, Halls’s translator role, Douglas’s foreword and Essai sur le don as the uniform original title. Direct browser opening failed because application/xhtml+xml is unsupported; indexed metadata only.

theodor_w_adorno.locator: PDF pages 5–6, title and copyright leaves
theodor_w_adorno.scope: Publisher frontmatter identifies joint authors Max Horkheimer and Theodor W. Adorno, editor Gunzelin Schmid Noerr, translator Edmund Jephcott and original printing 2002. These are metadata/credit facts, distinct from limited circulation 1944 and revised publication 1947. No new substantive reading of the prefaces, chapters or book is claimed. This bibliographic credit does not retrospectively identify the unspecified English edition/translator of the separately scoped online Culture Industry excerpt.

charles_tilly.scope: Publisher author/title metadata identifies Charles Tilly and the title ending AD 990–1992. The current paperback is dated February 1993; the biography’s original title/copyright page dates AD 990–1990 to 1990. Frozen release year 1992 is retained without treating this page as certification of every manifestation. No chapter/body reading or date repair.

alexis_de_tocqueville.scope: Publisher identifies Alexis de Tocqueville, Democracy in America and the 2000 edition edited/translated by Harvey C. Mansfield and Delba Winthrop, separately identifying the original two-part 1835/1840 publication. Supports English/French title concordance; it does not assign all 59 frozen work-key citations to this translation or to one original part. Metadata only; no body reading.

sigmund_freud.scope: Library metadata identifies an English revised Three Essays on the Theory of Sexuality, Hogarth Press, London, 1962, naming Sigmund Freud and editor James Strachey. This corroborates a 1962 manifestation, separately from the museum’s 1905 original-publication witness. Metadata only; individual citations’ editions, translation details and the book body are not independently collated.
